title: Siquijor elected officials — source snapshots
limitations: The DILG source does not identify provincial-board districts or include ex-officio provincial-board seats.
February2026 DILG and DBM2026 disagree on the Lazi and SanJuan vice-mayor names; both source readings are documented on the website.
Zero, blank, and short unqualified contact codes are not published as telephone numbers. Missing contacts are null, never fabricated.

sources.publisher: Department of the Interior and Local Government
sources.title: Directory of LGU Elective Officials for Term 2025–2028 as of February 2026
sources.coverage: Sixty municipal and ten provincial elected-office records; source rows 27145–27214. A dated directory snapshot, not a live tenure register.
sources.provenance: Directory linked from DILG key-officials; DILG FOI response to request DILG-322932022542 directs requesters to the DILG LGU Directory.
